decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir fits the firm's core hydraulic steel and weir business, so continuing it costs little even though results are still unproven, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product.

The energy management system is a software-oriented step away from the core business, much like the fouling detection products and web tool the firm quickly withdrew, so it is at higher risk; it is still too young for a shortfall against aspirations to be judged, so the firm keeps it for now.
The overflow flap gate has its own page and is a close extension of the established water-level regulation business, signalling commitment and likely results near the aspiration level.
